A '''Morseerian child''' with [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin was part of a group of [[Youngling/Legends|children]] orphaned during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Morseerian/Legends|Morseerian]] and the others were kidnapped on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] [[Kuvuta Pindi]]<ref name="Strange Allies">''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]''</ref> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The battle takes place just prior to the ''Secret Missions'' series.</ref> as part of a [[Slavery/Legends|trafficking]] ring led by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Dool Pundar]]. Pindi posed as a member of the [[Republic Children's Aid]] organization and claimed to be bringing the Morseerian and other children to a placement center on the planet [[Foless/Legends|Foless]]. She first transported them to the world of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]; claiming that their [[Transport/Legends|transport]] never arrived, she conned the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]]<ref name="Strange Allies" /> and the [[Human/Legends|Human]]&ndash;[[Moggonite/Legends|Moggonite]] [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] biker [[Gizman|Gizz]]<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> into taking them. On Foless, two members of the [[Foless Spaceport Authority]] identified the Twi'lek as matching the description of a person who had kidnapped children from Abregado-rae. As the Jedi and swoop jockey became suspicious of the Twi'lek woman's motives, the woman instructed the Morseerian and other children to board an [[Airbus/Legends|airbus]], on which she fled&mdash;she intended to use the Morseerian and his companions as hostages if need be. The airbus crashed, and the woman escaped, only to die a short time later. The children were rescued and placed with families.<ref name="Strange Allies" />
